{C:81930100}{C:81958296393400000000}What do you mean, enemies?
There shouldn't be anyone for us to fight.

{C:81930600}{C:819582963A3400000000}Calm down!
You're a man! Don't panic!

{C:81930100}{C:819582963B3400000000}Dad?

{C:81930600}{C:819582963C3400000000}Good, you can hear me?
Without a ship,
we can't get to you.

{C:819582963D3400000000}I'll give you instructions from the ground.
Just do what you can to hold out.

{C:81930300}{C:819582963E3400000000}No way...
We can't do this, Dad!

{C:81930600}{C:819582963F3400000000}It's all right. You two can do it.
I'll give you a brief explanation of combat.

{C:81958296403400000000}If you fight as I explain, at least
we should be able to keep the city from harm.
Please, do your best.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296413400000000}Okay, I'll try!

{C:81930600}{C:81958296423400000000}First, calm down and look at the top of the monitor.

{C:81958296433400000000}You should see data labeled HP and EN
up there.
Do you see it?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296443400000000}The top of the screen? ...Oh, this?
I found it, Dad.

{C:81930600}{C:81958296453400000000}Good. I'll explain HP first.
This {C:819782830400}HP{C:819782830000} reading
shows the Norstan's durability.

{C:81958296463400000000}In other words,
when the Norstan's HP reaches zero,
we lose--

{C:81958296473400000000}Conversely,
we win by reducing the enemy's HP to zero.
...Do you understand?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296483400000000}Yeah.
Basically, before the Norstan runs out of HP,

{C:81958296493400000000}we just have to get their ship's HP
down to zero, right?

{C:81930600}{C:819582964A3400000000}Exactly.

{C:819582964B3400000000}Next is the {C:819782830400}EN{C:819782830000} reading.
This value
shows the Norstan's energy.

{C:819582964C3400000000}Whenever the ship takes action,
such as deploying a unit,
it almost always consumes EN.

{C:819582964D3400000000}If you run short of EN in a crisis,
it could get you killed in the worst case.
Never waste it.

{C:819582964E3400000000}Now, I'll explain attacking.


{x00}

{C:81930600}{C:819582964F3400000000}In combat, both sides take turns.
Each turn is divided into a defense phase
and an attack phase.

{C:81958296503400000000}We attack, and the enemy defends.
The enemy attacks, and we defend.
Combat consists of repeating this cycle.

{C:81958296513400000000}Since we have the initiative,
this battle begins with the attack phase
of our turn.

{C:81958296523400000000}Now,
I'll explain the battlefield.

{C:81958296533400000000}The places where units can deploy are marked
by {C:819782830400}lanes{C:819782830000} connecting our side to the enemy's.


{x00}

{C:81930600}{C:81958296543400000000}There are six lanes.
Deployed units take up space
according to their width.

{C:81958296553400000000}For FT and GT units,
the standard unit width is two.

{C:81958296563400000000}Therefore,
a maximum of three machines
can stand side by side.


{x00}

{C:81930100}{C:81958296583400000000}So there's a front and a back?
What's the difference?

{C:81930600}{C:81958296593400000000}The drawback of the Forward position is
that it's easier to take damage,
but it also makes attacking easier.

{C:819582965A3400000000}Conversely, the Back position makes it
harder to take damage,
but it also makes attacking harder.

{C:819582965B3400000000}Choose the more suitable position
based on the enemy's situation
and the units you can deploy.


{x00}

{C:81930600}{C:819582965F3400000000}When a unit runs out of HP, it is damaged.
It can't deploy from the ship
until it receives the minimum repairs.

{C:81958296603400000000}However, units are repaired
every turn.

{C:81958296613400000000}If several units have been destroyed,
you can't choose which one
will be repaired that turn.

{C:81958296623400000000}To fight reliably,
try to avoid having units damaged
as much as possible.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296633400000000}Okay, I'll try.

{C:81930600}{C:81958296643400000000}As for EN,
you can basically think of it
just as you would a ship's.

{C:81958296653400000000}Next are unit attributes.

{C:81958296663400000000}First, units have location attributes: 
{C:819782830400}Ground{C:819782830000}, {C:819782830400}Anti-Air{C:819782830000}, and {C:819782830400}Flying{C:819782830000}.
These indicate their position.


{x00}

{C:81930600}{C:81958296683400000000}And GT-A
has the Ground location attribute.

{C:81958296693400000000}When units have the same location attribute,
there's no change, but...

{C:819582966A3400000000}when units with different attributes
fight, the effect is substantial.

{C:819582966B3400000000}Basically, Ground has the edge over Anti-Air. Flying has the edge over Ground. Ground has the edge over Anti-Air.

{C:819582966C3400000000}Remembering this three-way relationship
should prove useful.


{x00}

{C:81930600}{C:819582966D3400000000}Next, I'll explain another attribute.

{C:819582966E3400000000}Each unit has a range
at which it can attack.

{C:819582966F3400000000}{C:819782830400}Long Range{C:819782830000}, {C:819782830400}Short Range{C:819782830000},
and there are also 
{C:819782830400}Piercing units{C:819782830000} that attack at both short and long range simultaneously.


{x00}

{C:81930600}{C:81958296713400000000}And Short Range attack units
like GT-A
are probably better suited to the front.

{C:81958296723400000000}These Short Range, Long Range and Piercing types are called 
{C:819782830400}range attributes{C:819782830000}.
Make sure you remember them.

{C:81958296733400000000}Now, I'll get back to explaining the combat procedure.

{C:81958296743400000000}You need to give action orders
to the units you've deployed.


{x00}

{C:81930600}{C:81958296753400000000}Deployed units won't act
unless you give them orders like this.
Don't forget.


{x00}

{C:81930600}{C:81958296763400000000}Giving a unit an action order
consumes that unit's EN.

{C:81958296773400000000}Like the ship, it can't move if it runs short of EN,
so be careful.

{C:81958296783400000000}Once you've finished all actions and orders,
select Turn End,
and your units will advance on the enemy.


{x00}

{C:81930C00}{C:819582967A3400000000}They're being directed from the ground. With no combat experience at all... They'll be no trouble.


{x00}

{C:81930600}{C:819582967C3400000000}The enemy unit
seems to have chosen to defend.

{C:819582967D3400000000}An enemy that chooses to defend
can spend its defense power
to reduce our attack power.

{C:819582967E3400000000}What's more, that defense power value
only applies for one turn,
and is fully restored the next turn.

{C:819582967F3400000000}But that also means its defense power
doesn't recover during the turn.
It only decreases with each attack it takes.

{C:81958296803400000000}If we can deplete its defense power
all the way to zero,
we'll be able to damage it.

{C:81958296813400000000}Against a defending enemy, what matters is whether your attack can exceed its defense in one turn.


{x00}

{C:81930600}{C:81958296833400000000}Units act in order,
starting with the fastest.

{C:81958296843400000000}Basically, units taking action
advance toward the enemy ship
in order to attack it.

{C:81958296853400000000}And when units from both sides
are in the same lane,
they fight.


{x00}

{C:81930600}{C:81958296863400000000}As I thought, a defending unit
isn't easy to take down...

{C:81930100}{C:81958296873400000000}Damn it.

{C:81930600}{C:81958296883400000000}...But GT-B is next.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296893400000000}Huh?

{C:81930600}{C:819582968A3400000000}As I'm sure you know,
GT-B is a Long Range unit.

{C:819582968B3400000000}Normally, when other Ground units
are in the same lane, you can't pass them,
whether they're allies or enemies.

{C:819582968C3400000000}But GT-B, a Long Range unit,
can attack one space farther
than the normal attack range.

{C:819582968D3400000000}In other words, it can attack
the enemy in front of GT-A.


{x00}

{C:81930600}{C:819582968E3400000000}By using Long Range
and Short Range units this way,
you can attack in succession.

{C:81930100}{C:819582968F3400000000}Oh, I get it.

{C:81930600}{C:81958296903400000000}However!
There's something you must watch out for
when planning successive attacks.

{C:81958296913400000000}Even if, as before,
you put a Short Range unit in Forward
and a Long Range unit in Back,

{C:81958296923400000000}if the Short Range unit in Forward
is slower than the Long Range unit
you've placed in Back,

{C:81958296933400000000}the Long Range unit can't advance,
and its turn will end
before it reaches the enemy's position.

{C:81958296943400000000}Speed can easily lead to mistakes
in various other situations as well.
...Be careful.


{x00}

{C:81930C00}{C:81958296953400000000}For a first battle,
they're doing rather well...


{C:81930100}{C:81958296963400000000}Dad, it looks like they're going to attack.

{C:81930600}{C:81958296973400000000}Don't panic!
First, take a good look around
and understand the situation.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296983400000000}I got it!

{C:81930600}{C:81958296993400000000}Listen. When you switch from defense to attack,
ships and units recover.

{C:819582969A3400000000}Specifically,
ships and units replenish their EN.

{C:819582969B3400000000}And units aboard ships
recover
their HP.

{C:819582969C3400000000}What's more, one damaged unit
finishes its repairs and can deploy again.



{x00}

{C:81930100}{C:819582969D3400000000}What?
That unit's back in action?!

{C:81930600}{C:819582969E3400000000}Relax. It may be repaired,
but its HP shouldn't have recovered yet.
Even if it deploys now, it's no match for us.

{C:819582969F3400000000}More importantly...
it looks like another unit is coming.


{x00}

{C:81930100}{C:81958296A13400000000}That one in the back...
Didn't it just change lanes?

{C:81930600}{C:81958296A23400000000}Yes, it definitely moved.
...Right.
I'd better explain that too.

{C:81958296A33400000000}Deployed units can spend EN
to move to an adjacent lane,
or to Forward or Back.

{C:81958296A43400000000}Of course, a unit can't move once its action is decided, or if surrounding units leave it no room.



{x00}

{C:81930600}{C:81958296A73400000000}You can still attack
even when you're the defending side.

{C:81958296A83400000000}The only difference is
that you don't advance when attacking.


{x00}

{C:81930600}{C:81958296A93400000000}All right, you deploy too!

{C:81930100}{C:81958296AA3400000000}...Huh?
Oh, right!

{C:81930600}{C:81958296AB3400000000}Their units have the Ground attribute.
So Impulse 7, a Flying unit,
should have the advantage.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296AC3400000000}All right, leave it to me!


{x00}

{C:81930100}{C:81958296AD3400000000}Whoa!

{C:81958296AE3400000000}Dad!
Even if I have the advantage,
I can't take on two units!

{C:81930600}{C:81958296B03400000000}Don't panic. Listen carefully!

{C:81958296B13400000000}Against multiple units, attack power, defense power and damage are shared by contact area across their widths.


{x00}

{C:81930600}{C:81958296B23400000000}In this situation, GT-A takes
two-thirds of the damage
it would take fighting alone.


{x00}

{C:81930600}{C:81958296B43400000000}And Impulse 7 takes one-third
of the damage from each of them,
for a total of two-thirds as well.


{x00}

{C:81930600}{C:81958296B53400000000}That example
was about the damage our side takes.

{C:81958296B63400000000}Conversely, consider our attacks.
Each of them has to fight GT-A,
and on top of that...

{C:81958296B73400000000}each has to take half
of Impulse 7's attack.

{C:81958296B83400000000}Do you understand?
Then get out there!





{x00}

{C:81930600}{C:81958296BA3400000000}A unit that has spent its EN
can't act.

{C:81958296BB3400000000}In that case, it's better to have it {C:819782830400}Return{C:819782830000} to the ship
and replenish its EN.


{x00}

{C:81930600}{C:81958296BC3400000000}There's something
you need to watch out for here.

{C:81958296BD3400000000}First, returning to the ship
instantly replenishes EN,
but it doesn't replenish HP.


{x00}

{C:81930600}{C:81958296BE3400000000}Also, you can't return
during the defense phase.

{C:81958296BF3400000000}Make sure you get that into your head
while you have the chance.

{C:81958296C03400000000}Now, let's finish this in one go.




{x00}

{C:81930100}{C:81958296C23400000000}What is it...? I've got a bad feeling.


{x00}

{C:81930300}{C:81958296F43400000000}Big brother, you can use
the Astante's bombardment now!
Let me know if you need anything.


{x00}

{C:81930400}{C:81958296F93400000000}I'm telling you, this has nothing to do with me.


{x00}

{C:81930400}{C:81958296FC3400000000}Oh, I'll explain it myself!
Listen carefully!!

{C:81930100}{C:81958296FD3400000000}Y-yes!

{C:81930400}{C:81958296FE3400000000}There are several types of bombardment,
depending on their purpose.

{C:81958296FF3400000000}First, {C:819782830600}the main cannon targets the enemy ship.{C:819782830000}
You can use this when invading the enemy,
during the attack phase.


{x00}

{C:81930400}{C:81958296003500000000}Its effect is to {C:819782830600}deal damage directly
to the enemy ship{C:819782830000}.

{C:81958296013500000000}However, that only applies
when there are no enemy units
in the enemy's lane.

{C:81958296023500000000}If there are enemy units,
the damage for that lane
will go to those units instead.

{C:81958296033500000000}What's more,
the damage that hits units
is spread out,

{C:81958296043500000000}so it is
almost completely nullified.

{C:81958296053500000000}So, to ensure you deal damage,
you need to create a situation where it's difficult
for the enemy to deploy multiple units.


{x00}

{C:81930400}{C:81958296063500000000}Next is {C:819782830600}support bombardment.{C:819782830000}

{C:81958296073500000000}You can also use this during the attack phase to 
{C:819782830600}deal damage directly
to enemy units on the field{C:819782830000}.

{C:81958296083500000000}But even if this support bombardment
fails to hit a unit,
it won't deal damage to the ship.


{x00}

{C:81930400}{C:81958296093500000000}Finally, there's interception bombardment,
which attacks enemy units
when the enemy invades you.

{C:819582960A3500000000}Since interception bombardment can only
be used during the defense phase,
I'll explain it later.

{C:819582960B3500000000}All right, here I go.








{x00}

{C:81930400}{C:819582960D3500000000}Like support bombardment, interception bombardment can 
{C:819782830600}deal damage directly
to enemy units{C:819782830000}.

{C:81930100}{C:819582960E3500000000}Hmm...

{C:81930400}{C:819582960F3500000000}You don't understand?


{x00}

{C:81930400}{C:81958296123500000000}(Then I'll use that EN for bombardment, too.)


{x00}

{C:81930400}{C:81958296133500000000}Oh, I forgot: bombardment strength depends on the ship's capabilities and how much EN you spend.

{C:81958296143500000000}Plan your EN use carefully, considering deployment costs and whether leftover EN can carry over.

{C:81958296153500000000}Well then,
let's go welcome them too.




{x00}

{C:81930300}{C:81958296163500000000}Big brother, are you all right?


{x00}

{C:81930100}{C:81958296173500000000}Yeah, I'm fine.

{C:81958296183500000000}Even a flying unit
takes damage
when it faces ground units, huh.


{x00}

{C:81930400}{C:81958296193500000000}That's right.

{C:819582961A3500000000}But when attacking, your target is the ship,
so you don't need to engage
the ground units...

{C:819582961B3500000000}During the defense phase, your targets are units,
so you need to match
the enemy's position.

{C:819582961C3500000000}The damage doesn't seem serious,
but you'd better come back just in case.
Rie, is that all right?

{C:81930300}{C:819582961D3500000000}Yes,
repairs are fine.

{C:81930100}{C:819582961E3500000000}Repairs?

{C:81930300}{C:819582961F3500000000}Yes.
First, return to the ship.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296203500000000}Got it.
Give me a moment.


{x00}

{C:81930300}{C:81958296223500000000}Like bombardment,
the amount of HP you can restore depends
on capabilities and the amount of EN.

{C:81958296233500000000}So when you use it,
I think you should consider it carefully.
Good luck, then.

{C:81930400}{C:81958296243500000000}Everything clear?
I'll leave the remaining orders to you.
Let's finish this in one go.

{x00}

{C:81900300}{C:81958296833200000000}Huh? The Cloud Sea...

{C:81930100}{C:81958296843200000000}What's wrong, Rie?

{C:81900300}{C:81958296853200000000}Something about the Cloud Sea looks strange.

{C:81900400}{C:81958296863200000000}The Cloud Stream's concentration has increased.
It's exceeded the Astante's tolerance.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296873200000000}Exceeded its tolerance?
Does that mean we...

{C:81900400}{C:81958296883200000000}Yes. We can't leave
this continent anymore.

{C:81900300}{C:81958296893200000000}What do we do, big brother?!

{C:81930100}{C:819582968A3200000000}It might be a natural phenomenon,
so there's nothing we can do.

{C:819582968B3200000000}We'll just have to wait
for the Cloud Stream's concentration to fall.

{C:81900300}{C:819582968C3200000000}Yeah...

{C:81930100}{C:819582968D3200000000}Meanwhile, let's gather information on the Norstan
and learn about this continent.
We can't do anything else, anyway.

{C:81900300}{C:819582968E3200000000}You're right!
There's no point worrying about it.

{C:819582968F3200000000}That's my big brother!
You're so positive.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296913200000000}Flattery won't
get you anything, you know.




{x00}

{C:81930100}{C:81958296B63200000000}All right! We're finally here!!
I'm going to have a good look around!

{C:81900400}{C:81958296B73200000000}Wait a minute.
I'm coming with you.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296B83200000000}What is it, Nelfea?

{C:81900400}{C:81958296B93200000000}Professor Rondo asked me to come, too.
I can't leave the scouting
to someone as carefree as you.

{C:81958296BA3200000000}That's why I'm coming.
Got it?


{C:81900300}{C:81958296BB3200000000}Hmph...

{C:81930100}{C:81958296BC3200000000}What's wrong, Rie?

{C:81900300}{C:81958296BD3200000000}If Nelfea's going,
then I'm going too!!

{C:81930100}{C:81958296BE3200000000}Oh, fine! Do whatever you want!

{C:81958296BF3200000000}(What on earth
 is Rie so angry about?)


{x00}

{C:81930100}{C:81958296C03200000000}Hey, Rie,
have you seen Nelfea?

{C:81900300}{C:81958296C13200000000}I don't know.
Isn't she in the hangar?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296C23200000000}No, she isn't.
I wanted to see her about something.

{C:81900300}{C:81958296C33200000000}Do you want to check the ship's monitors?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296C43200000000}Hmm, no.
I'll look for her myself.



{x00}

{C:81900400}{C:81958296C53200000000}Claudia...
I can't see it anymore.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296C63200000000}(Nelfea... Of course.
 She may act tough, but she's still a child.)

{C:81900400}{C:81958296C73200000000}Professor... I wonder how you're doing.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296C83200000000}Are you lonely?

{C:81900400}{C:81958296C93200000000}O-of course not!
What are you talking about?!

{C:81958296CA3200000000}Of course I'm worried.
Unc... the Professor isn't here.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296CB3200000000}I know you can't rely on me
as much as Professor Rondo, but...

{C:81958296CC3200000000}I'll work hard too.
I'll get stronger, so you can count on me.

{C:81900400}{C:81958296CD3200000000}Is something wrong with your head?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296CE3200000000}That's harsh, Nelfea!

{C:81900400}{C:81958296CF3200000000}Well, do your best.

{C:81958296D03200000000}(Thank you.)

{C:81930100}{C:81958296D13200000000}(That's right. Unless I get stronger,
 I won't be able to get Lun back.)

{x00}

{C:81900300}{C:81958296923200000000}How's the Cloud Stream
looking, Nelfea?

{C:81900400}{C:81958296933200000000}Hmm, right now... Oh.
The Cloud Stream's concentration is rising.

{C:81958296943200000000}...Just as I thought.
We can't get out again.

{C:81900300}{C:81958296953200000000}Then we'll have to
gather information again.

{C:81900400}{C:81958296963200000000}That's right.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296973200000000}(I couldn't get a word in...)

{x00}

{C:81900400}{C:81958296983200000000}It's the same here. The concentration is rising.
We can still get out now. What will you do?

{C:81900300}{C:81958296993200000000}We can carry on, can't we, big brother?

{C:81930100}{C:819582969A3200000000}Yeah.
We have to enter
some continent or other, anyway.

{C:81900400}{C:819582969B3200000000}And we need information on the Norstan.

{C:81900300}{C:819582969C3200000000}Exactly.

{C:819582969D3200000000}With any luck,
we might find more people
willing to join us.


{x00}

{C:81930400}{C:81958296D23200000000}Is that a blip on the radar?

{C:81930300}{C:81958296D33200000000}Should we prepare for battle?

{C:81930400}{C:81958296D43200000000}There's only one machine,
so I don't think we need to go that far.

{C:81930300}{C:81958296D53200000000}Then I'll ask
my brother to go out.



{x00}

{C:81930300}{C:81958296D63200000000}Big brother!
An unidentified flying object is approaching.
Go out in Impulse 7 and take a look.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296D73200000000}Understood. I'll launch right away.


{x00}

{C:81900400}{C:81958296D83200000000}Is that the machine that came from the Cloud Sea?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296D93200000000}Yes, but...
It's obviously an FT, isn't it?

{C:81900300}{C:81958296DA3200000000}Is there anything in the cockpit?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296DB3200000000}I'm looking right now, aren't I?
...Oh, here it is.
I'll put it on the monitor.


{x00}

{C:81930700}{C:81958296DC3200000000}Good work on your mission to pursue the Norstan.
That's what Akatsuki
would probably say, but...

{C:81958296DD3200000000}Above all, I'm concerned
about your safety.

{C:81958296DE3200000000}So, to ease your burden even a little,
I've sent the newly developed 
{C:819782830400}ＦＴ－Ⅱ Cloud Saber{C:819782830000}.

{C:81958296E03200000000}I'm sure you can handle it.
Protect Rie and Nelfea for me.
I'm counting on you.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296E13200000000}I know, Professor.

{C:81900300}{C:81958296E23200000000}Make sure you protect us, big brother.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296E33200000000}Still, the Professor takes some crazy risks.
What was the plan
if we hadn't picked it up?

{C:81900400}{C:81958296E43200000000}What are you talking about?!
Unc... the Professor would never
do something like that without being sure.

{C:81900300}{C:81958296E63200000000}Then how did the Professor
know where we were?
